anim.description: Grants the animation plugin's default commands and native file pickers to the main window.

campaign.description: Grants the campaign plugin's storage, image import/read and progress commands to the main window, plus the open/save dialogs used to import and export campaigns and panorama images.

conquest.description: Grants the conquest plugin's galaxy storage and run-state commands to the main window, plus the open/save dialogs used to import and export galaxies.

content.description: Grants the content plugin's default commands and the native folder picker to the main window.

default.description: Base capabilities for the main window.

downloads.description: Grants the downloads plugin's default commands to the main window.

hub.description: Grants the hub plugin's sign-in commands to the main window.

lego.description: Grants the unit builder's project storage, thumbnail and reveal commands to the main window, plus the save dialog used to choose where a unit is exported.

lobby-servers.description: Grants the lobby-servers plugin's keychain credential commands to the main window.

mapconv.description: Grants the mapconv plugin's default commands and native file pickers to the main window.

mcp.description: Dev-only: grants the MCP plugin's default commands (console-log forwarding) to the main window. Inert in release builds where the plugin is not registered.

multiplayer.description: Grants the multiplayer lobby client's connection and state commands to the main window.

play.description: Grants the play plugin's start-script generation, engine launch and cancel commands to the main window, plus the save dialog used to export a start script.

profile.description: Grants the distribution-profile loader command to the main window.

runlite.description: Grants the roguelite-run plugin's active-run and meta-progression storage commands to the main window.

scenario.description: Grants the scenario plugin's storage and dialogue-media commands to the main window, plus the open dialog used to pick a portrait, voice clip or scenario file and the save dialog used to export one.

uberstress.description: Grants the uberstress plugin's default commands plus native file dialogs and folder opening to the main window.

unitsync.description: Grants the unitsync content-scan command to the main window.
